root.command: SELECT ro.ID AS OrderID, c.CustomerID, c.CompanyName, ro.ReoccuranceType, ro.[Value] AS TargetDayOfMonth, ro.DateLastDone, ro.NextDateRequired, DateDiff("d", Now(), ro.NextDateRequired) AS DaysUntilNext, ro.Enabled FROM ReoccuringOrderTbl AS ro INNER JOIN CustomersTbl AS c ON ro.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE ro.ReoccuranceType = 5 AND ro.Enabled = True ORDER BY ro.[Value], c.CompanyName

SELECT ro.ID AS OrderID, c.CompanyName, ro.[Value] AS TargetDayOfMonth, ro.DateLastDone, ro.NextDateRequired, DateDiff("d", Now(), ro.NextDateRequired) AS DaysUntilNext, IIF(ro.NextDateRequired <= DateAdd("d", 9, Now()), 'YES', 'NO') AS InReminderWindow FROM ReoccuringOrderTbl AS ro INNER JOIN CustomersTbl AS c ON ro.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE ro.ReoccuranceType = 5 AND ro.Enabled = True AND ro.NextDateRequired <= DateAdd("d", 9, Now()) ORDER BY ro.NextDateRequired

SELECT 'Current Date (Now)' AS Description, Now() AS CalculatedDate, Day(Now()) AS DayOfMonth UNION ALL SELECT 'Next Month Day 1' AS Description, DateSerial(Year(DateAdd("m", 1, Now())), Month(DateAdd("m", 1, Now())), 1) AS CalculatedDate, 1 AS DayOfMonth UNION ALL SELECT 'Days Until Next Month Day 1' AS Description, DateSerial(Year(DateAdd("m", 1, Now())), Month(DateAdd("m", 1, Now())), 1) AS CalculatedDate, DateDiff("d", Now(), DateSerial(Year(DateAdd("m", 1, Now())), Month(DateAdd("m", 1, Now())), 1)) AS DayOfMonth

SELECT 'Total Monthly Recurring Orders' AS Category, COUNT(*) AS OrderCount FROM ReoccuringOrderTbl WHERE ReoccuranceType = 5 AND Enabled = True UNION ALL SELECT 'Orders with NextDateRequired within 9 days' AS Category, COUNT(*) AS OrderCount FROM ReoccuringOrderTbl WHERE ReoccuranceType = 5 AND Enabled = True AND NextDateRequired <= DateAdd("d", 9, Now()) UNION ALL SELECT 'Orders with NextDateRequired in the past' AS Category, COUNT(*) AS OrderCount FROM ReoccuringOrderTbl WHERE ReoccuranceType = 5 AND Enabled = True AND NextDateRequired < Now()

SELECT ro.ID, c.CompanyName, ro.[Value] AS TargetDay, ro.DateLastDone, ro.NextDateRequired, DateDiff("d", ro.DateLastDone, Now()) AS DaysSinceLastDone, DateDiff("d", Now(), ro.NextDateRequired) AS DaysUntilNext, IIF(Day(Now()) >= 27 AND ro.[Value] = 1, 'PROBLEM CASE', 'OK') AS Status FROM ReoccuringOrderTbl AS ro INNER JOIN CustomersTbl AS c ON ro.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE ro.ReoccuranceType = 5 AND ro.Enabled = True AND ro.[Value] <= 5 ORDER BY ro.[Value], c.CompanyName
